rationale.intuition: Stanford overall ~3.8% RD. Test-optional 在 T5 unhooked 通常显著 penalty (Common App data: no-score admit at 60-75% of test-submitter rate at T20). Perfect GPA + strong ECs 部分弥补，但缺乏 SAT 在 Stanford 这种高分校尤其 penalize。Industry 区间 2-6%。Confidence ≤ medium 反映 test signal 缺失。

sources.name: Stanford CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall RD admit rate 3.80%; ~70% submit test scores, suggesting TO pool is self-selected (often hooked or unique)

sources.name: Common App Test-Optional Report 2024
sources.evidence: T20 schools admit no-score applicants at 60-75% of test-submitter rate (5-10pp absolute gap)

sources.name: Counselor Engine testBandMultiplier
sources.evidence: applyingTestOptional=true at <5% accept schools gets ×0.85 modifier
